newsitem.title: BELGIUM: AHK adds 6th Brussels-HK flight from Nov.
newsitem.headline: AHK adds 6th Brussels-HK flight from Nov.

text.p: Air Hong Kong (AHK) said it will increase the number of weekly Boeing 747-200 flights between Brussels and Hong Kong from five to six from early November.

"Increasing capacity on this route to six freighter flights per week,during periods of peak market demand, is an established practice for us," Marcel Buelens, AHK's Continental Europe general manager cargo, told Reuters.

Yesterday ANK, which is 75 percent owned by Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd 0293.HK) said it was increasing ex-Europe air cargo rates to Dubai, Hong Kong and Japan by five percent from October 1. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
